remarks: Bright & Newer with your own private entrance, this 800 sq. ft. 1-bedroom/1-bath in the desirable Fairgate community is located on the brim of vibrant downtown Stamford, and aims to please with large sunny rooms, designer kitchen w/new granite countertops, new carpet + fresh paint. Beautifully set along the sidewalked streets + mature trees of Fairgate, residents enjoy a meticulously maintained, pet-friendly community, with on-site management, 24-hour security, and can walk across the street to popular Fairgate Farm! Central A/C, economical gas heat, 5-star energy rated appliances And NO ADDITIONAL FEES, put this great space on your "must see" list! Applicants must complete the Fairgate application uploaded in supplements and credit check through Applyconnect only. There are 2 parking spaces only if there are 2 tenants, 1 car per tenant.
